Summary
This page summarizes your Adobe Tags property: counts and sizes of rules, data elements, and extensions, and identifies unused components. You can download the summary as a PDF for audit reports, or copy each table and paste it into email for quick discussions.
Unused data elements are inferred from the compiled library JSON in this scan only. Custom code that exists only in remote hosted files (for example Adobe CDN bundles) is not downloaded or analyzed, so the unused list may omit references that exist only in those files. On the Data Elements tab you can run an optional deep scan to fetch and scan those HTTPS bundles, then merge results into the table.
